text:
zoe: quick experiment proposal: multi-touch PLG pilot tying a benchmark blog + social launch + gated webinar + 30 credits + 3 prompt templates. goal: improve 7-day activation and surface leads for SDR.
mira: love the stack. what's the concrete hypothesis?
zoe: hypothesis: combined touch (blog + social + webinar + credits) lifts 7-day activation by 9% and yields 8-12 sales-ready leads from the seed cohort. primary metric = pct signup -> first 3 gens in 7d. secondary = # of "sales:hot" leads created.
cal: segment idea: signups in last 28 days, usage=0, not on paid trial. exclude existing customers. cal: i'll assemble and export.
ev an: i'll host the 35m webinar Tue May 7 11:00. can do a short demo + live prompt walkthrough.
mira: routing: RSVP flow includes 1-question form (company size). if size > 50 or checkbox "enterprise interest" checked -> tag sales:hot and push to SDR queue via HubSpot. sdr-bot will create lead.
sdr-bot: reminder: integration key needed for HubSpot auto-create. ping @cal to confirm mapping.
zoe: tracking plan: add utm_source=benchmark_launch&utm_medium=social_email_webinar and route=benchmarkkit param on banner and blog CTA. use route param to identify channel-driven traffic vs organic.
cal: for AB, test banner copy short vs benefits-led on homepage only. email copy will be consistent. split exposed:control = 65:35 to preserve power and bigger holdback.
mira: credit logic: attendance-only grant of 30 credits, T+0.5d nudge if credits unused. credit workflow requires approval from ops-bot.
ops-bot: workflow "grant_credits_v4" requires approval from @mira before cohort write.
ev an: RSVP page draft ready at https://redwood.example/rsvp-benchmark (mock). includes hidden input route=benchmarkkit.
zoe: blog: short benchmark narrative showing baseline vs pilot KPI (time-to-first-run, avg tokens/first-run). include mini graph and callout for webinar. theo -> can you draft? (cc @mira)
mira: i'll draft the prompt pack (3 prompts): 1) TL;DR a meeting transcript, 2) Tone-shift rewrite for product copy, 3) Brainstorm feature variations. keep each under 3 lines.
cal: shared folder: https://drive.redwood.example/benchmark_launch with RSVP mock, CTA options, and segment csv (private).
ev an: question about control: 65/35 exposed/control ok. do we randomize per user or cookie?
cal: randomize at user id to avoid cross-device bleed.
z oe: QA checklist in short: segment export, hubspot mapping, approval on credit workflow, RSVP page with utm+route, prompt pack asset, webinar deck, analytics dashboard (signup->rsvp->attend->first-run), and alert if attend < 30% of RSVPs.
mira: assign tasks: cal = segment + export + banner AB; evan = host + RSVP page + deck; zoe = blog + social + influencer shortlist; mira = prompt pack + credit approval; sdr-bot = hubspot mapping + lead create test.
sdr-bot: test lead created: PASS (sandbox).
cal: I'll spin up banner AB tomorrow AM and drop shard configs in drive.
ev an: deck uploaded by monday EOD.
zoe: influencer shortlist: 6 micro-influencers, offer early product access + co-promote. will DM list here later.
mira: sync tues 10am for go/no-go. quick ask: keep banner copy concise. short CTA: "Get 30 credits + 3 prompts  Join our webinar"; long CTA: "Join a short demo + get 30 starter credits and 3 prompts to ship faster."
cal: noted. implementing AB. will add tracking param ?utm_source=benchmark_launch&utm_medium=banner&utm_campaign=may7&route=benchmarkkit to RSVP links.
zoe: final: let's ensure analytics tag for first-gen event includes attribution by utm+route so we can slice by channel. evan will you confirm SDK fires for first-gen?
ev an: confirmed. will run smoke tests after AB goes live.
mira: thanks team :rocket:
